Vanessa — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below.

- Reseller AWS seller ID: 123456789012
- Invoice routing: CloudResell prefers to be billed directly by AWS (marketplace billing to reseller), then we invoice the end-customer for managed services. If Redwood needs consolidated billing, we can explore a split but it requires extra tax/AR setup on our side.
- Legal / SOW: I attached the draft SOW and our standard reseller addendum. No special VAT rules for this US-based customer, but we’ll confirm if the end-customer has EU entities.
- Pricing floor: We require a 10% minimum margin on reseller-discounted list to protect channel economics. If Redwood has a promotional discount, flag it so we can review.

I can do the 30-min ops call on Jan 6 at 09:30 PT. If you want Ben/Diego on the call that’s fine — I’ll bring our account ops lead.

Vanessa / team —

Thanks Amy for the detail. Internal ops notes and recommended approach below (flagging Diego and Connor for action items).

1) CPPO enablement checklist (ops):
   - Confirm reseller seller ID (Amy provided 123456789012) and validate with AWS partner ops.
   - SKU mapping: Connor to match Redwood SKUs -> AWS product codes in CPPO template. Expect a short follow-up for missing codes.
   - Entitlement provisioning: Diego to own the entitlement keys configuration and test using a small staging customer.

2) Invoice routing recommendation:
   - Preferred path (lowest ops friction): CloudResell billed directly by AWS, reseller invoices end-customer for services. This reduces our billing reconciliation work and avoids double invoicing.
   - Alternative (requires more work): Consolidated billing to Redwood + split via internal revenue sharing. If the customer insists on a single invoice from Redwood, legal will need to sign off (we should avoid unless necessary).

3) Pricing floor and margin — commercial:
   - Accept the 10% minimum margin ask as a starting point. We’ll keep promotional discounts off the CPPO base pricing and use a limited-time redemption code if we need to run promos.

4) Documents & signatures:
   - I’ll draft a short Ops Annex to the SOW that captures the SKU list, entitlement mapping, and invoice routing. Vanessa — can you confirm if we should push the DocuSign flow this week? I’ll prepare the annex and tag legal if necessary.

Action owners:
- Diego Fernandez: entitlement keys + test (ETA Jan 12)
- Connor O'Brien: SKU mapping completion (ETA Jan 8)
- Vanessa Ortiz: schedule joint ops call with CloudResell + AWS (tomorrow 09:30 PT)

Internal note: mark SOW as restricted — do not share pricing sheets outside of the participants on this thread until legal approves.

—
